usageContract: Nodes, elements, bend geometry, section/material states and restraints in this export are AUTHORITATIVE and already validated against BM4_NL's real CAESAR output (see M044/M045/M046 in the source repository). Downstream analysis work must not re-derive bend tangent trims, tee end-springs/offsets, or restraint linearization from source InputXML/ accdb data -- consume this export as-is and iterate ONLY on additional physics/analysis mechanics layered on top of it (e.g. an extra initial-strain or load term), analogous to how M045 adds pressure elongation without touching geometry.
